findings: auto can choose a call or a direct response.
any forces a function call; none prohibits function calls.
validated checks function-schema adherence; documentation does not establish that every request must call a tool.
The exact model supports low/medium/high thinking; minimal is unsupported and returns an error.
The current version is v1beta; Interaction.required contains status only.
The POST SSE response declares [DONE] as its sentinel.
GenerationConfig declares max_output_tokens, seed, stop_sequences, thinking_level, thinking_summaries and tool_choice.
CreateModelInteraction includes labels; its presence in the schema does not establish model/account availability.
FunctionCallStep requires id, name, arguments and type.
Interactions structured output uses response_format.type=text, mime_type=application/json and schema.
Only a subset of JSON Schema is supported; parsed JSON should be validated against that schema.
Only final output is returned by default; auto enables thought summaries.
A simple request can yield a signature-only thought step. Empty or absent summary is allowed.
